senses.gloss:
वृथा वृथा, ind. (said to be fr. rt. वृ;
according to some for वर-था), without trouble,
(in Ṛg-veda IX. 76, 1 = अन्-आयासेन); without
pain, without difficulty, with ease, easily (Ved.);
without necessity, unnecessarily, uselessly, fruitlessly,
in vain; unprofitably; foolishly, idly, wantonly,
falsely; wrongly, incorrectly; vain, purposeless, use-
less, fruitless; (if compounded with articles of food,
वृथा is said to mean ‘hot’); [cf. Gr. ῥεῖα, βρᾶ,
ῥᾷ, ῥάῐστος, ῥᾴδιος, &c.]
—वृथा-कथा, f. idle
talk, nonsense.
—वृथाकार (˚था-आक्˚), अस्, m. a
false form, mere appearance, empty show.
—वृथा-
कुल-समाचार, अस्, आ, अम्, whose family and prac-
tices are low.
—वृथाघात (˚था-आघ्˚), अस्, m.
striking uselessly, killing unnecessarily.
—वृथा-
जन्मन्, अ, n. useless or unprofitable birth.
—वृ-
थाट्या (˚था-अट्˚), f. going or strolling about in an
idle manner, travelling for pleasure (regarded as a
vice in a king; Manu VII. 47).
—वृथा-दान,
अम्, n. useless or improper gift, a gift that may be
annulled (or if promised, not made good, as a gift
promised to courtezans, wrestlers, or money lost at
play, &c.; according to some there are sixteen kinds
of these gifts).
—वृथा-पशु-घ्न, अस्, m. the
slayer of an animal wrongly or unnecessarily (i. e. not
for sacrifice).
—वृथा-प्रतिज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, one who
makes a promise rashly.
—वृथा-भू, cl. 1. P. -भ-
वति, &c., to be in vain, to be useless, to be frustrated.
—वृथा-भोग, अस्, आ, अम्, enjoying in vain or
to no purpose.
—वृथा-मति, इस्, इस्, इ, foolish-
minded, wrong-minded.
—वृथा-मांस, अम्, n.
‘useless flesh,’ i. e. flesh not destined for the gods or
Pitṛs, (the eater of such flesh is said to be born as a
goblin); (अस्), m. one who eats such flesh.
—वृ-
थालम्भ (˚था-आल्˚), अस्, m. cutting or plucking
unnecessarily, (Manu XI. 144.)
—वृथा-वादिन्, ई,
इनी, इ, speaking falsely.
—वृथा-श्रम, अस्, m.
vain exertion, useless labour.
—वृथा-षाह्, -षाट्,
m., Ved. one who easily overcomes or conquers,
(Sāy. = अनायासेन शत्रूणाम् अभिभविता, Ṛg-
veda 1. 63, 4.)
—वृथा-सङ्कर-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, born
in vain by the mixture of different castes, one who
neglects to perform his duties.
—वृथोत्पन्न (˚था-
उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, born or produced in vain.
